author_vs_adaptation: The company-fact/definition review is this project adaptation. Method author has not been established to recommend or analyze these specific companies.
selection_scope: Three saved examples within the1819-company intake;2 sector hints. Selected to inspect structural/model-input differences, not investment ranking or performance evidence.

companies.company_name: しずおかフィナンシャルグループ

Company holding-group regulatory capital versus operating-bank consolidated/solo scope.
Capital reserve/payout/annual-forecast basis is separated from reinvestment prediction.
companies.research_model_state: financial_equity_model_review supported as a research route; valuation inputs unadopted
do_not_substitute: Accounting equity ratio8.0% for regulatory capital ratio.
Disclosed required-capital8% calculation or observed16.24% ratio for complete buffers/target or a monetary annual reinvestment.
Published buyback ceiling for completed purchases or distributable surplus.

Published payout/buyback policy and annual NI.
companies.conditional_next_evidence: If adopting a financial model, obtain same-period capital definition/target/buffers and forward earnings/RWA/reinvestment bridge; a definitional gap alone does not justify an IR message.

companies.company_name: アイリックコーポレーション
saved_issuer_scope_supported: Company describes insurance product selection/direct shops, franchise operating support and four service lines including software/FA.
companies.research_model_state: Both ordinary and financial-equity applicability remain unassessed; business-service description is evidence, not proof of groupwide absence of underwriting.
do_not_substitute: Insurance industry tag for underwriting risk, contract liabilities or bank-like regulatory capital requirements.
Shop count and software description for segment financial weight, future profit or model fit.
IR_public_answers_to_exclude: Whether the company describes shops/selection support/FC/technology services.
companies.conditional_next_evidence: If model adoption needs it, inspect a bounded issuer financial/segment original for revenue/fee recognition, group boundary and debt/capital role before a company-definition inquiry.

companies.company_name: ライフネット生命保険
saved_issuer_scope_supported: Saved FAQ names individual/group-credit-life business and assets supporting insurance payments.
Company explains consolidated IFRS adoption and Japanese-GAAP standalone surplus-distribution basis.
Accumulated-loss/distribution-timing statements are historical saved company explanation, not fresh current balances or future DPS.
companies.research_model_state: Accounting/entity/equity-cashflow scope review; legal underwriting, IFRS17/CSM, liabilities, regulatory requirements and DDM/FCFE applicability remain unverified.
do_not_substitute: Consolidated IFRS profit for standalone Japanese-GAAP distributable amount or an unconditional future DPS series.
Generic acquisition-cost deferral explanation for a verified company accounting estimate.
Historical unspecified dividend timing for a numerical zero-dividend forecast or sell instruction.
IR_public_answers_to_exclude: The saved FAQ already states the accounting/adoption and distribution-basis distinction.
The saved FAQ already describes insurer-side payment-related asset-management purpose.
companies.conditional_next_evidence: Before selecting a model, inspect appropriate current entity-specific financial and distribution/capital definitions. Do not ask IR to guarantee dividend timing or validate investor forecasts.

limits: All-company-current eligibility/financial freshness and15-case investment readiness are unverified.
Financial/method dependencies are not a requirement to obtain all24 template facts for every company.
7157 provenance is saved visible text in a historical evidence JSON; original HTTP entity/wire/current freshness unverified.
Publicly described operations or accounting rules do not establish all group liabilities or current legal distributable surplus.
No industry-only exclusion, low-volatility rejection or blanket financial-company PER prohibition. No prices or liquidity data were reviewed here.
